reddit.title: Introducing Materials Instead of Cost Badges in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made a significant update to how building materials are displayed in Provincia! Instead of a single cost badge, each paid build entry now features a comprehensive **Materials** control. This allows you to see exactly what resources are stored and what is required, with any shortages clearly highlighted. This change aims to enhance your building experience by providing more transparency and control over your resources. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges

steam.title: Update: Materials Instead of Cost Badges
steam.body: We're excited to announce a new update in Provincia that changes how you view building materials. Each paid build entry now shows a **Materials** control, allowing players to see the exact resources needed for construction, including what is stored and what is lacking. This feature is designed to provide a better overview and improve your building strategy. For more details, visit: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
